messages:
sara_customer: Hi team — signed up via Azure marketplace and activated the Accelerator offer (partner:azure-accelerator-2025) but the free credits aren’t showing in our Redwood billing page. Order ID: AZ-ORD-99213. Can someone check?

nina_support: sorry to hear that — can you confirm the Azure subscription ID and the email used to sign up? sometimes marketplace -> platform linking fails if the acct email differs.

sara_customer: Subscription ID: 6f8a2c3d-az. Email: sara@acme-prod.com. The marketplace confirmation email shows the charge and promo code applied. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/screenshot123.png

nina_support: thanks. I’ll look up the mapping. tagging billing: @ryan_billing — could be a delayed webhook or missing order reconciliation.

ryan_billing: I see the marketplace order in our ingestion pipeline but it never reconciled to a customer account (order metadata missing "redwood_account_id"). usually that means the customer completed the marketplace flow but didn’t click the final redirect that links accounts.

sara_customer: we definitely clicked the link. the marketplace shows the subscription active.

nina_support: quick repro steps for us: 1) check marketplace order id -> AZ-ORD-99213 2) validate partner code (azure-accelerator-2025) 3) ensure webhook delivered to /internal/marketplace/notify 4) look for mapping entry in ledger_export->marketplace_mappings.

mike_eng: past issues were due to a malformed Content-Type header from Azure (application/json; charset=utf-8) causing our lambda to silently drop the mapping. I’ll grep logs for that order id.

billing-bot: webhook-received AZ-ORD-99213 at 2025-06-11T15:34:09Z, status: 200 OK, payload-id: wb_0a7c

mike_eng: logs show a 422 on our mapping handler for payload-id wb_0a7c — error: "missing field: redwood_external_id". Looks like Azure did not include our redirect param.

ryan_billing: two options: (A) ask customer to re-run the marketplace link flow (fastest), or (B) we manually attach the marketplace credit after verifying invoice and subscription. For (B) I need the Azure invoice PDF and the marketplace purchase confirmation.

sara_customer: I can share the invoice. uploading now: https://files.acme.example/invoice-AZ-99213.pdf

nina_support: thanks. @ryan_billing please escalate to Billing Ops with ticket BA-4581. Include subscription ID, order id, invoice link, and that the webhook payload lacked redwood_external_id. Request manual credit application.

ryan_billing: opened BA-4581 and assigned to billing-ops. ETA for manual credit is 3 business days after verification. I’ve also added a temporary note to Sara’s account so our console shows pending credits.

mike_eng: I’ll follow up with infra to patch the handler to accept alternate linking fields from Azure and emit a non-fatal warning instead of dropping the payload.

nina_support: Sara — apologies for the friction. If you’re comfortable re-running the sign-up link, it usually fixes mapping instantly. Otherwise keep an eye on the account — I’ll DM when BA-4581 moves. :thumbsup:

sara_customer: re-run link would be fine if you can give me the link. otherwise ok to do manual. thanks for the quick responses.

nina_support: sending the secure re-link in DM now.

ryan_billing: marking thread for follow-up. last update on BA-4581: docs uploaded, verification in progress.

sara_customer: thanks all!
